idea.name: Local Marketplace arbitrage

claims.quote: Hey, I'm 5 minutes from you. I can come get this right now.

idea.name: Deal feed for resellers

claims.claim: The speaker says millions of Americans resell daily or weekly.

claims.claim: The example describes a seller moving $300 treadmills multiple times per week and making thousands per month.
claims.quote: guy selling $300 treadmills, multiple a week, making thousands of dollars a month

claims.claim: The speaker suggests such a reseller might pay $30 to $150 per month for a deal-finding tool.
claims.quote: he'll probably pay $30 to $150 a month for a little tool that helps him find more deals or better deals.

claims.claim: The speaker gives $29.99 per month as an example software price.
claims.quote: It's only $29.99 per month.

acquisition_channels.details: Post about the tool in local reseller and flipper Facebook groups.

ideas.delivery: Send a spreadsheet by email daily or weekly, or provide an automated software feed.
ideas.other_uk_rules: UK GDPR may apply if the feed stores identifiable seller data. Recurring software subscriptions may engage DMCC Act subscription rules.
